subject: Independent control over axis lines in 0.9.2

messages.author: 066b54eefceeb668
messages.subject: Independent control over axis lines in 0.9.2
parts:
I'm not able to modify one or the other axis lines using version 0.9.2. 
Using the following base plot:

      library(ggplot2)
      (baseplot = ggplot(data.frame(x = 1:10, y = 1:10), aes(x,y)) + geom_point() )

I can modify both axis lines using:

     baseplot +  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1))

But I can't modify the x axis line only using:

     baseplot + theme(axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1))
 
The results appears to be the same as the base plot (i.e., no modification to the x axis line).  Am I doing something wrong?

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Independent control over axis lines in 0.9.2
parts:
Hi:

Because of the inheritance structure built into the new theming system, the way to do it is to modify axis.line and then use element_blank() on axis.line.y:

baseplot +  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1),
                           axis.line.y = element_blank())

axis.line.x will inherit from axis.line and you'll get the behavior you expect.

Dennis

messages.author: 066b54eefceeb668
messages.subject: Re: Independent control over axis lines in 0.9.2
parts:
Hi Dennis,
Thank you so much for you reply. You code works, but only if one axis line is to be modified and the other is to be removed.
But what if I want to modify both axis lines: x-axis line coloured red and y-axis line coloured blue. It seems I can't do that.

Version 0.9.2 gives me independent control over other x and y elements. For instance I can independently modify the tick marks:

      baseplot + theme(axis.ticks.x  = element_line(colour = "red", size = 2),
                       axis.ticks.y = element_line(colour = "blue", size = 2))

Or I can independently modify the grid lines:

      baseplot + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "red", size = 1),
                       panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "blue", size = 1))

But it seems the same style of code will not work to independently modify the axis lines:

      baseplot + theme(axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "red", size = 1),
                       axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "blue", size = 1))

Is there a way to apply different modifications to the axis lines?

Thanks
Sandy

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: Independent control over axis lines in 0.9.2
parts:
This is one area where the theme inheritance combined with the default
theme isn't an improvement on the old system...

The problem is that in the default theme_grey(), axis.line is set to
element_blank(), and the two elements that inherit from axis.line,
axis.line.x and axis.line.y, inherit the blank element. Perhaps it
would be a little easier the default for axis.line was this:
theme(axis.line = element_line(colour=NA))

At any rate, this should do the trick - you just need to set axis.line
to something that's not element_blank():

qplot(1:3, 1:3) +
theme(axis.line = element_line(),

axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "red", size = 1),
axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "blue", size = 1))
